titleBack: I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you have one captive of ability > 2 at a Jabba's Palace site, OR two captives at Jabba's Palace site(s).

children.req: can-spot (count 1): captive of ability > 2 at a Jabba's Palace site
can-spot (count 2): two captives at Jabba's Palace site(s)

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you have NO captives at Tatooine sites AND opponent has NO character at the same site as a Rancor.

children.req: can-spot: any captive at a Tatooine site
can-spot: opponent character at same site as Rancor

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is a captive-count check via can-spot AT Jabba's Palace sites (Filters.at), not control/occupy; alternatives: 2 plain captives OR 1 captive with abilityMoreThan(2).
Captive spots use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE (captives are normally invisible to spotting).
Flip-back is a double negative: no captives at Tatooine SITES (broader than Jabba's Palace) and no opponent character co-located with a Rancor.

Front maintenance: at end of EACH player's deploy phase, that player loses 1 Force unless that player has a non-droid character AT a Tatooine battleground site (Filters.owner(currentPlayer) + Filters.at(Filters.Tatooine_battleground_site)) - applies to BOTH players (Card110_006.java:120-131).
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Audience Chamber, Great Pit Of Carkoon, and Dungeon from Reserve Deck (Card110_006.java:51-75).

Front once per deploy phase (COURT_OF_THE_VILE_GANGSTER__DOWNLOAD_DOCKING_BAY_OR_INDEPENDENT_STARSHIP): deploy one docking bay or [Independent] starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Narrows to docking bays only under COURT_OF_THE_VILE_GANGSTER__MAY_NOT_DEPLOY_STARSHIPS mod (Card110_006.java:78-100, filter :85-86).
Back once per deploy phase (I_SHALL_ENJOY_WATCHING_YOU_DIE__DOWNLOAD_SARLACC_RANCOR_OR_RANCOR_PIT): deploy Sarlacc, Rancor, or Rancor Pit from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card110_006_BACK.java:51-70).
otherObligations: Front: bounty hunters forfeit +2 and immune to Goo Nee Tay deploy-cost modifiers (Card110_006.java:107-108); YOU may not play Scanning Crew (:109).
Front maintenance loss: each player loses 1 Force at end of their deploy phase without a non-droid character at a Tatooine battleground site (Card110_006.java:120-131).
Back: captives targeted by Trap Door relocate to Rancor Pit without destiny draw (TRAP_DOOR__DO_NOT_DRAW_DESTINY) and Trap Door may not be canceled (Card110_006_BACK.java:75-76).

Back: opponent loses Force equal to forfeit of each opponent character eaten by Rancor/Sarlacc; eaten character placed out of play (EatenByIsPlacedOutOfPlayModifier :77; LoseForceEffect trigger :91-100).
Strategic: after flip, keep at least one captive at a Tatooine site OR keep an opponent character stuck with the Rancor, else it flips back to front.
No hard-lose/out-of-play condition on either side.
